'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Facility (Regional Development)|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

== Participation Criteria ==
Complete side mission [[A Painting Open for Business]] objective [Run the Inn].

{{Color|※ Complete main mission [Chapter II Process VII: [[Paint with Fresh Ink]]] to unlock the mission [A Painting Open for Business].|9}}

== Inn Rating Details ==
* '''Inn Rating:'''
** Once the requirements are met, use the Rate Now feature to increase the Inn Rating.
** Increasing the Inn Rating unlocks new Innkeeping features such as recipes, renovations, themes, and assist roles.
** Increasing the Inn Rating adds more tables, raises the limits of drinks and dish options in the menu, increases Tip Bonus: Inn, Tip Bonus: Choice, and Patron Limit.
* '''Inn Stars:'''
** Inn Stars can be earned by reaching more ★ in various theme.
** You can earn up to 5★ for each theme.
** Inn Stars are required fro increasing Inn Rating.
* '''Patrons:'''
** Formally opening the Inn for business serves a number of patrons. You cannot start an Innkeeping session if the number of patrons is too low.
** Increasing Inn Rating can raise the Patron Limit and give a one-time replenishment of numerous patrons (this can exceed the Patron Limit),
** Patrons slowly regenerate over time until the limit is reached.

== Ingredients ==
{{Stub}}
=== Farm ===
* Area for farming crops
* Auto-Farmer: A facility manufacture by Endfield Industries to automate agricultural production. Upgrading an Auto-Farmer to the required levels will let it perform actions such as Auto-Germination and Auto-Harvest.
** Collected ingredients are stored in the Auto-Farmer Storage until limit reached. Can be remotely moved to Wuling [[Depot]].
** Auto-Farmer in [[Si's Painting]] must be upgraded using [[Spirit Money]]

=== Ranch ===
* Area for raising beasts.
* Stable plots can be purchased using [[Spirit Money]].
* Beasts must be fed to produce ingredients.
* Ingredients are automatically collected and can be remotely stored in Wuling [[Depot]].

== Events ==
[[File:Yuanyuan's Blazing Stoves event.png|center|400px|link=Yuanyuan's Blazing Stoves]]

{{Main|Yuanyuan's Blazing Stoves}}
'''Yuanyuan's Blazing Stoves''' is an exclusive limited-time event for the [[Sanctuary of Ink]] version that launches at the same time as '''Yuanyuan Manor Inn'''. During the event, complete specific tasks in '''Yuanyuan's Blazing Stoves''' to claim rewards such as [{{I|Oroberyl|gv=false}}] or [{{I|Mark of Perseverance|gv=false}}].
